metadata.purpose: ERA sensitivity evaluation — 25 condition-relevant routing queries.
design_notes: All origins and destinations are real Magdeburg places verified in Neo4j (buildings, stops, landmarks).
All queries are mode-neutral ('get from X to Y', not 'drive to X') so the orchestrator enriches all alternatives and ERA gets to compare modes.
Distance distribution: 5 short (<1km, walk-dominant), 12 medium (1-3km, all modes feasible), 8 long (>3km, transit/drive-dominant).
Each query tagged with dominant_exposed_mode — the mode whose ERA score is most expected to react to weather/AQ/darkness changes.

distance_categories.short: <1 km, walking is the natural primary mode
distance_categories.medium: 1-3 km, all modes feasible (walking, cycling, transit, driving)

dominant_exposed_mode.walking: Outdoor-exposure-relevant; walk score should drop most under bad weather
dominant_exposed_mode.cycling: Outdoor-exposure-relevant; bike score should drop most under bad weather and ice
dominant_exposed_mode.transit: Lower exposure (covered cars + brief walks); score should be more stable across weather
dominant_exposed_mode.driving: Minimal exposure; score should react mainly to traffic and parking, not weather
